sloka: तत् समाकुल सम्भ्रान्तम् मत्त सम्कुपित द्विपम् ।हय शिन्जित निर्घोषम् पुरम् आसीन् महा स्वनम् ॥२-४०-१९॥
transliteration: tat samākula sambhrāntam matta samkupita dvipam ।haya śinjita nirghoṣam puram āsīn mahā svanam ॥2-40-19॥

translations.english: The city was distressed and flurried by the intoxicated elephants, provoked by the mighty sound of the tinkling of bells and the neighing of the horses.
